state_observations.refresh_rule: Do not use observed head values as live invariants. Before any execution/reconciliation, reread each present provider/host/DBR root and compare against its current owner/authority, then produce a signed/readback receipt.

identities.node: Authenticated host/compute device identity independent of printer machine identity and agent identity
identities.printer_individual: One persistent hardware/digital CGX machine Object_ID; self-expansion preserves identity even as components change
identities.child_printer: Independently functional nested electronic printer holds its own child Object_ID; host parent assembly membership is relation not authority inheritance
identities.bay: Allocated passive or tool-supported manufacturing space, not itself an agent/CGX independent individual
identities.passive_part: Assembly child/instance of global type reference, material and origin attributes; no forced standalone machine
identities.canonical_source: Native Drive/Git/CAD/instrument identity distinct from Object_ID and rendered view

memory_classes.semantic: owner-controlled CGX domain object/state, not automatic side-chat promotion
memory_classes.episodic: DBR task/run/stage and historical receipts, evidence and calibration traces
memory_classes.temporary: per-query task packet/hydration cache, discardable within selected user/safety policy
memory_classes.private: user-local private/profile/context sidecars, not auto-imported into Römer or shared/public CGX
memory_classes.co_running_chat: not canonical by conversation alone; persist agreed differences through existing owner branch/receipt, then derive source-linked projection

traverse only task-reachable admissible dependency subgraph
respect evidence/unknown classes and final dependency receipts
select a single primary view with on-demand secondary projections

query_contract.escalation: Hydrate an additional dependency/specialist only on an unresolved required field/constraint, material claimed functional effect, environment hazard, user request, or current owner-approved evidence; explicit source/size/compute budget required.
query_contract.evidence_rules: Candidate/simulated results remain candidate. Missing input remains unknown or bounded approved measurement sweep. Only proven/readback/committed results can parameterise dependent tests.
query_contract.model_selection: no_model_deterministic, classical_solver, optional local LLM, optional remote specialist depending on verified capabilities; model is not agent identity and no model may independently authorise actuation.

promotion: Never automatically close an external-owner frontier or alter another owner PR. Crosslane intelligence should circulate via typed source refs and explicit admission stages, with selective dependency hydration and independent owner review.

sibling_legacy_alignment.clarification: CGX is live semantic object/namespace with stable Object_ID/source ownership; representation/carrier can be sparse and provider-distributed. A visual/file/CAD/assistant projection is not a new object master.
sibling_legacy_alignment.crystallisation: task/user/surface/device-permission projection over one semantically sourced state, bounded by evidence and security; no automatic change in object or root authority
sibling_legacy_alignment.view_rule: Existing CGX View Selection Policy chooses at most one primary view and on-demand relevant secondary views; task/requester identity does not override admission, evidence or privacy.
sibling_legacy_alignment.collaboration: Ephemeral dialogue/presence may be transient; independently attributable user/operator decisions and reviewed proposals persist as scoped events/DBRs/overlays. Workspace CRDT/optimistic merges do not self-promote semantic canon.
sibling_legacy_alignment.provider_rule: Drive/Git/Canva/CAD/local files are provider representations with native source identity. No copying entire sibling project content into the printer for coverage metrics.
sibling_legacy_alignment.node_rule: Web surfaces/phones/hydration clients are not enrolled compute/physical nodes solely by opening CGX; device handshake + capability attestation + scoped lease are separate.
sibling_legacy_alignment.non_authority: Sibling packet labels are proposal or recommendation only, even if newer. Close its owner decisions in their lane; PrintSpace consumes only approved exact-revision source evidence.
